title: Digital Platforms Required to Detail Reporting Channels for Violence Against Women
seoTitle: Platforms Detail Channels for Reporting Violence
subtitle: Federal Government Demands Online Services Describe Victim Support Mechanisms
excerpt: Digital platforms have 15 days to inform the federal government about the operation of their channels for reporting violence against women.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Digital platforms will be given a suggested 15-day period to inform the federal government about the operation of their channels and mechanisms for reporting violence against women in the digital environment.

This measure aims to make access to support resources more transparent for victims and ensure that reporting tools are aligned with public policies to combat gender-based violence.

By detailing procedures, service flows, and referral criteria, companies are expected to facilitate communication between users and competent authorities, thereby contributing to the effectiveness of prevention and protection measures.

With information from Agência Brasil.
